# Fryman Canyon Estates

> Fryman Canyon Estates is the hyperlocal guide to the Fryman Canyon neighborhood of Studio City, California, presented by Misraje Real Estate Partners. Jack Misraje and Karen Misraje are the real estate agents serving Fryman Canyon and the surrounding Studio City hills.
